interfaces.notes: Order building, lines 121-137: symbols = sorted(current | targets); skip when the price is missing or NaN (124-126). exiting = tw == 0 and cw > 0. exits_only skips when tw >= cw. forced = s in force and tw < cw. BUY: buy_px = px*(1+slip); qty = math.floor(min(delta_val, cash)/(buy_px + commission)) (150-151); reason add/entry. Returns the fill dicts. interfaces.signature: _fill(self, sym: str, qty: int, px: float, date: str) -> dict
interfaces.notes: fill_px = px*(1+slip) for a buy, px*(1-slip) for a sell. cost = qty*fill_px + abs(qty)*commission, and cash -= cost. A buy averages into avg_cost or creates {qty, avg_cost: fill_px, entry_date, peak_close: px, last_price: px}. A sell sets realized = (fill_px - avg_cost)*(-qty), adds qty, and deletes the position when qty <= 0 (line 176). Returns {date, symbol, side, qty: abs(qty), price: round(fill_px,4), value: round(abs(qty)*fill_px,2), realized_pnl: round(realized,2)}. news_live.py:207 and :218 also call _fill directly, so it is shared with the news book.

interfaces.signature: _chart(sym: str, rng: str, interval: str) -> dict
interfaces.notes: GETs CHART_URL with params {range, interval, events:'div,splits'} and returns chart.result[0], else RuntimeError. There is no period1/period2 mode and no dataGranularity check. Also used by market_status, live_prices, official_opens, dashboard.py:16 and news_live.py:31.

interfaces.signature: _bars_from_chart(res: dict) -> pd.DataFrame
interfaces.notes: Index = timestamps converted to meta.exchangeTimezoneName (default America/New_York), normalized and made naive. Duplicates keep the last; rows with NaN close are dropped. open/high/low are scaled by adjclose/close, close = adjclose. For crypto (tz UTC, adjclose == close) the ratio is 1, so D+1's partial row is kept with its open.

interfaces.signature: fetch_daily(sym: str, rng: str = '5y', max_age_hours: float = 6.0) -> pd.DataFrame

interfaces.signature: fetch_panel(symbols: list[str], rng: str = '5y', max_age_hours: float = 6.0) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]
interfaces.notes: Runs 8 threads. Failed or empty symbols are only printed and are absent from the columns (L141-146). Returns {open, high, low, close, volume}. A row is kept if at least max(1, int(0.5*n)) closes exist (L151), so with 2 coins a D+1 row present for BTC only is kept with ETH NaN.
